Now, I can not start sampling because some probability in categorical logit is 0.

Hi Tomoki,

I'll just start out with a problem in your program that's going to force things not to work unless K = S. If they aren't equal, perhaps fixing this will fix the rest of your program.

You've declared your variable p as
  simplex[K] p[N,S];

The way you're indexing the simplex is incorrect:

for(i in 1:N){
    for(k in 1:K){
      p[i,k][1] = Phi((c[1]-mu[k]-tau[i])/(sigma[i]*sigma_bar[k]));
      for(s in 2:(S-1)){
        p[i,k][s] = Phi((c[s]-mu[k]-tau[i])/(sigma[i]*sigma_bar[k])) - Phi((c[s-1]-mu[k]-tau[i])/(sigma[i]*sigma_bar[k]));
      }
    }

It should be:
for (n in 1:N) {
  // simplex[K] p_n[S];
  // p_n = p[n];
  for (s in 1:S) {
   // simplex[K] p_ns;
   // p_ns = p[n, s];
   // p_ns = p[n][s];
    for (k in 1:K) {
       // real p_nsk;
       // p_nsk = p[n][s][k];
       // p_nsk = p[n, s][k];
       // p_nsk = p[n, s, k];
       p[n, s, k] = ...
    }
  }
}

In comments, I've shown the different types that you get by indexing at different levels. Hopefully that makes sense and you can fix that part of the model. I'm sure if the sizes aren't equal, then you'll end up either going past the size of the array or simplex, or you'll end up with NaN elements.

Try fixing that and seeing if it fixes the program.



Daniel
